contributions.detail: Consumes the canonical Explore read-model seam from PR #19. Encounter-security PR #32 @ 08b39ec90bb1162de45858eac1851da88c4a7093 and A2A PR #37 @ f1b2075618696fdaeba4da6111904205f295af76 remain the authority/admission owners for hosted mutation, private Contact/Watch state and A2A exchange; this desktop reading exposes none of those mutation powers or private relations. SpaceTimeDB transport identifiers remain non-canonical.

Consumes verified Actuation PR #6 head b977939ec25c32b3dc8f5ed251b70e4c26933086, including explicit portable RootScope and MetagencyGrant envelopes. Root Agency remains a positional relation between WorldBinding and RootScope; O:I does not introduce a RootAgent subtype or infer metagency from presentation.

Consumes Central PR #53's native Personal/root-world Action surface. Authored Control/Work remain filesystem-owned by Central; proposal is derived until explicit acceptance, and notification delivery is not human acknowledgement. O:I only hosts the reading and Action refs.

Consumes Factory PR #146's current source-owned @epilogos/factory-build-surface contract at 95bd5425de6f6d4a355ad6260ca2e1d74e28bf04: BuildSurface accepts FactoryBuildView directly and preserves separate semantic/live/trajectory depths. Factory owns Project/Run/RunMap-frontier/Candidate/Claim/Evidence/HumanRequest, Agency/Return and Execution/trajectory refs. Its FactoryActionView supplies product-native ActionRefs and BuildSurface emits only {actionRef, subjectRef}; O:I does not copy exemplar state or mint Action names. SessionSpaceRef is accepted only as an opaque AIKit-owned ref now that aikit.session-space/v1 is real; Factory and O:I do not own its lifecycle or authority. Because the source package is still private and O:I #21 has no native install/register lifecycle bridge, no live FactoryBuildView instance is claimed in the desktop yet; contract hosting is degraded rather than pending or falsely full.

Consumes the actual AIKit SessionSpace implementation at PR #68 head beae44c9b9f40565dcae24b4dceac91a3258bf44: durable session-space/... identity, aikit.session-space/v1, SessionSpaceReadModel, AgentSession/component/Surface/connection projections and explicit lifecycle/activation/connection states. SessionSpaceAuthorityState keeps capability availability, capability grant and Action authorisation separate; presence in a SessionSpace does not grant authority. O:I has no live SessionSpace instance binding yet and AIKit's exact head is not fully green, so this remains a degraded read-only contract rather than a fabricated Active workspace.

Consumes AIKit PR #68's target-neutral nested Component topology as a read-model contract at current producer head beae44c9b9f40565dcae24b4dceac91a3258bf44. The same PR owns staged HarnessComposition mutation, ACP connection and terminal working-field projection. Rich UI, HumanCommand, Policy and LoopRuntime contributions remain target-native; O:I does not mount Cordis, reinterpret protocol commands as Actions, or create a desktop plugin ontology.
